sentences.title: Clarify with Professor
sentences.meaning: Asking a teacher or professor to explain a concept once more
hi: सर, फिर से समझाइए
Sir, phir se samjhaiye
en: Sir, could you please explain that again?
Sur, kood yoo pleez ek-splayn dhat uh-gen?
bn: স্যার, আবার বুঝিয়ে বলবেন?
Sir, abar bujhiye bolben?

sentences.title: Central Library
sentences.meaning: Asking for the location of the campus central library
hi: सेंट्रल लाइब्रेरी कहाँ है?
Central library kahan hai?
en: Where is the central library?
Wair iz dhuh sen-truhl ly-brer-ee?
bn: সেন্ট্রাল লাইব্রেরিটা কোন দিকে?
Central library-ta kon dike?

sentences.title: Project Deadline
sentences.meaning: Asking classmates about final assignment submission date
hi: प्रोजेक्ट सबमिशन की आखिरी तारीख कब है?
Project submission ki aakhiri tareekh kab hai?
en: When is the project submission deadline?
Wen iz dhuh proj-ekt suhb-mish-uhn ded-lyn?
bn: প্রজেক্ট জমা দেওয়ার শেষ তারিখ কবে?
Project joma deowar shesh tarikh kobe?
te: ప్రాజెక్ట్ సబ్మిట్ చేయడానికి చివరి తేదీ ఎప్పుడు?
Project submit cheyadaniki chivari thedi eppudu?

sentences.title: Borrow Class Notes
sentences.meaning: Asking a classmate to share their handwritten or digital notes
hi: क्या मुझे आज के क्लास नोट्स मिल सकते हैं?
Kya mujhe aaj ke class notes mil sakte hain?
en: Can I borrow your lecture notes for today?
Kan eye bah-roh yoor lek-chur nohts for tuh-day?
bn: আজকের ক্লাসের নোটগুলো একটু দেখতে দেবে?
Aajker class-er note-gulo ektu dekhte debe?

sentences.title: Lab Venue
sentences.meaning: Inquiring about practical laboratory room and venue
hi: कल का प्रैक्टिकल लैब कहाँ होगा?
Kal ka practical lab kahan hoga?
en: Where will tomorrow's practical lab be held?
Wair wil tuh-mah-roh'z prak-tih-kuhl lab bee held?
bn: কালকের প্র্যাকটিক্যাল ল্যাবটা কোথায় হবে?
Kalker practical lab-ta kothay hobe?

sentences.title: Enter Faculty Cabin
sentences.meaning: Polite permission before entering faculty office or class
hi: क्या मैं अंदर आ सकता हूँ, प्रोफेसर?
Kya main andar aa sakta hoon, professor?
en: May I come in, Professor?
May eye kum in, proh-fes-er?
bn: প্রফেসর, আমি কি ভেতরে আসতে পারি?
Professor, ami ki bhetore aashte pari?

sentences.title: Desk in Classroom
sentences.meaning: Checking if a bench or desk is occupied before sitting
hi: क्या यहाँ कोई बैठा है?
Kya yahan koi baitha hai?
en: Is this seat taken?
Iz dhis seet tay-kuhn?
bn: এই সিটটায় কেউ বসেছে কি?
Ei seat-tay keu boseche ki?

sentences.title: Attendance Sheet
sentences.meaning: Checking the circulation of the student roll sheet
hi: अटेंडेंस शीट यहाँ तक पहुँच गई क्या?
Attendance sheet yahan tak pahunch gayi kya?
en: Has the attendance sheet reached here?
Haz dhuh uh-ten-duhns sheet reecht heer?
bn: অ্যাটেনডেন্স শিটটা কি এদিকে এসেছে?
Attendance sheet-ta ki edike esheche?

sentences.title: Chai and Samosa
sentences.meaning: Ordering classic Indian evening snack combination
hi: एक चाय और समोसा देना
Ek chai aur samosa dena
en: One tea and a samosa, please
Wun tee and uh suh-moh-suh, pleez
bn: একটা চা আর একটা সিঙ্গাড়া দিন
Ekta cha aar ekta singara din

sentences.title: Less Sugar Chai
sentences.meaning: Customizing your beverage sweetness preference
hi: चाय में चीनी कम रखना, भैया
Chai mein cheeni kam rakhna, bhaiya
en: Please make the tea with less sugar
Pleez mayk dhuh tee with les shoo-gur
bn: চায়ে চিনি একটু কম দেবেন, দাদা
Chaye chini ektu kom deben, dada
te: టీలో చెక్కర కొంచెం తక్కువ వేయండి, అన్నా
Tea-lo chekkara konchem thakkuva veyandi, anna

sentences.title: Mess Menu
sentences.meaning: Inquiring about today's meal preparation in the hostel mess
hi: आज मेस में खाने में क्या बना है?
Aaj mess mein khaane mein kya bana hai?
en: What is on the hostel mess menu today?
Wuht iz on dhuh hos-tuhl mes men-yoo tuh-day?
bn: আজকে হোস্টেল মেসে কী রান্না হয়েছে?
Aajke hostel mess-e kee ranna hoyeche?

sentences.title: No Onion, No Garlic
sentences.meaning: Specifying dietary preference or satvik food requirements
hi: यह बिना प्याज और लहसुन के बनाना
Yeh bina pyaaz aur lehsun ke banana
en: Please prepare this without onion and garlic
Pleez pree-pair dhis widh-out uhn-yuhn and gar-lik
bn: এটা পেঁয়াজ-রসুন ছাড়া বানিয়ে দেবেন
Eta peyaj-roshun chara baniye deben

sentences.title: Cold Coffee & Sandwich
sentences.meaning: Ordering cold drinks and quick snacks at the cafeteria
hi: एक कोल्ड कॉफ़ी और वेज सैंडविच मिलेगा?
Ek cold coffee aur veg sandwich milega?
en: Can I get one cold coffee and a veg sandwich?
Kan eye get wun kohld koh-fee and uh vej sand-wich?
bn: একটা কোল্ড কফি আর ভেজ স্যান্ডউইচ হবে?
Ekta cold coffee aar veg sandwich hobe?
te: ఒక కోల్డ్ కాఫీ, వెజ్ శాండ్‌విచ్ దొరుకుతుందా?
Oka cold coffee, veg sandwich dorukuthunda?

sentences.title: Drinking Water
sentences.meaning: Asking for filtered potable drinking water location
hi: यहाँ पीने का साफ़ पानी कहाँ मिलेगा?
Yahan peene ka saaf paani kahan milega?
en: Where can I find drinking water here?
Wair kan eye fynd dring-king wah-tur heer?
bn: এখানে খাবার জল কোথায় পাব?
Ekhane khabar jol kothay pabo?

sentences.title: Pack as Takeaway
sentences.meaning: Requesting takeaway meal container
hi: इसे पार्सल पैक कर दीजिए
Ise parcel pack kar deejiye
en: Please pack this for takeaway
Pleez pak dhis for tayk-uh-way
bn: এটা পার্সেল প্যাক করে দিন
Eta parcel pack kore din

sentences.title: Total Canteen Bill
sentences.meaning: Asking for the total canteen bill amount due
hi: कुल कितना बिल हुआ, भैया?
Kul kitna bill hua, bhaiya?
en: How much is the total bill?
How much iz dhuh toh-tuhl bil?
bn: দাদা, মোট কত বিল হলো?
Dada, mot koto bill holo?

sentences.title: Auto to Campus
sentences.meaning: Hailing an auto-rickshaw to college campus
hi: भैया, कैंपस चलोगे?
Bhaiya, campus chaloge?
en: Will you take me to the campus?
Wil yoo tayk mee too dhuh kam-puhs?
bn: দাদা, ক্যাম্পাসে যাবেন?
Dada, campus-e jaben?

sentences.title: Meter or Fixed Fare
sentences.meaning: Confirming if auto driver will follow official meter
hi: मीटर से चलोगे या फिक्स किराया है?
Meter se chaloge ya fix kiraya hai?
en: Will you run by meter or fixed fare?
Wil yoo ruhn by mee-tur or fikst fair?
bn: মিটারে যাবেন নাকি নির্দিষ্ট ভাড়া?
Meter-e jaben naaki nirdishto bhara?

sentences.title: Metro Token or Card
sentences.meaning: Purchasing metro transit tokens or recharging smart card
hi: मेट्रो कार्ड या टोकन कहाँ मिलेगा?
Metro card ya token kahan milega?
en: Where can I buy a metro card or token?
Wair kan eye by uh meh-troh kard or toh-kuhn?
bn: মেট্রোর কার্ড বা টোকেন কোথায় কাটব?
Metro-r card ba token kothay katbo?
te: మెట్రో కార్డు లేదా టోకెన్ ఎక్కడ కొనుక్కోవాలి?
Metro card leda token ekkada konukkovali?

sentences.title: Bus to Station
sentences.meaning: Finding the right bus route to the train terminal
hi: हावड़ा स्टेशन के लिए कौन सी बस जाएगी?
Howrah station ke liye kaun si bus jaayegi?
en: Which bus goes towards the railway station?
Which buhs gohz tuh-wardz dhuh rayl-way stay-shuhn?
bn: হাওড়া স্টেশনের দিকে কোন বাসটা যাবে?
Howrah station-er dike kon bus-ta jabe?
te: రైల్వే స్టేషన్ వైపు ఏ బస్సు వెళ్తుంది?
Railway station vaipu ae bus velthundi?

sentences.title: Drop at Main Gate
sentences.meaning: Specifying drop-off point to auto or cab driver
hi: मुझे मेन गेट के पास उतार देना
Mujhe main gate ke paas utaar dena
en: Please drop me near the main gate
Pleez drop mee neer dhuh mayn gayt
bn: আমাকে মেইন গেটের সামনে নামিয়ে দেবেন
Aamake main gate-er shamne naamiye deben

sentences.title: Metro Stop Check
sentences.meaning: Confirming train stopping at destination station
hi: क्या यह ट्रेन एस्प्लेनेड मेट्रो पर रुकेगी?
Kya yeh train Esplanade metro par rukegi?
en: Does this train stop at Esplanade?
Duhz dhis trayn stop at Es-pluh-nayd?
bn: এই ট্রেনটা কি এসপ্ল্যানেড স্টেশনে থামবে?
Ei train-ta ki Esplanade station-e thambe?

sentences.title: Time to Airport
sentences.meaning: Estimating travel duration through city traffic
hi: यहाँ से एयरपोर्ट पहुँचने में कितना समय लगेगा?
Yahan se airport pahunchne mein kitna samay lagega?
en: How long will it take to reach the airport?
How long wil it tayk too reech dhuh air-port?
bn: এখান থেকে এয়ারপোর্ট পৌঁছতে কতক্ষণ লাগবে?
Ekhan theke airport pouchhote kotokkhon lagbe?
te: ఇక్కడి నుండి ఎయిర్‌పోర్టుకు ఎంత సమయం పడుతుంది?
Ikkadi nundi airport-ku entha samayam paduthundi?

sentences.title: Ticket to Destination
sentences.meaning: Purchasing a single transit journey pass
hi: पार्क स्ट्रीट के लिए एक टिकट दीजिए
Park Street ke liye ek ticket deejiye
en: Please give me one ticket to Park Street
Pleez giv mee wun tik-uht too Park Street
bn: পার্ক স্ট্রিটের একটা টিকিট দিন
Park Street-er ekta ticket din

sentences.title: Price per Kilo
sentences.meaning: Asking fruit/vegetable price in street bazaar
hi: ये आम कितने रुपये किलो हैं?
Ye aam kitne rupaye kilo hain?
en: How much are these per kilogram?
How much ar dheez pur kil-oh-gram?
bn: এই আমগুলো কিলো কত করে?
Ei aam-gulo kilo koto kore?

sentences.title: UPI Payment Option
sentences.meaning: Asking shopkeeper about QR digital transaction
hi: क्या यहाँ गूगल पे या यूपीआई चलेगा?
Kya yahan Google Pay ya UPI chalega?
en: Do you accept UPI or QR code payment?
Doo yoo ak-sept yoo-pee-eye or kyu-ar kohd pay-muhnt?
bn: এখানে কি গুগল পে বা ইউপিআই নেওয়া হবে?
Ekhane ki Google Pay ba UPI neowa hobe?
te: ఇక్కడ గూగుల్ పే లేదా యూపీఐ తీసుకుంటారా?
Ikkada Google Pay leda UPI theesukuntara?

sentences.title: Locate QR Standee
sentences.meaning: Locating merchant payment scan code
hi: आपका पेमेंट स्कैनर कहाँ रखा है?
Aapka payment scanner kahan rakha hai?
en: Where is your payment QR code scanner?
Wair iz yoor pay-muhnt kyu-ar kohd skan-ur?
bn: আপনার কিউআর কোড স্ক্যানারটা কোথায়?
Aapnar QR code scanner-ta kothay?
te: మీ పేమెంట్ క్యూఆర్ కోడ్ ఎక్కడ ఉంది?
Mee payment QR code ekkada undi?

sentences.title: Bargain Discount
sentences.meaning: Polite bargaining in street shopping
hi: भैया, थोड़ा दाम कम कर लीजिए ना
Bhaiya, thoda daam kam kar lijiye na
en: Can you give a small discount, please?
Kan yoo giv uh smawl dis-kownt, pleez?
bn: দাদা, দামটা একটু কম রাখা যাবে না?
Dada, daam-ta ektu kom rakha jabe na?

sentences.title: Cash Change
sentences.meaning: Requesting smaller cash denomination from shopkeeper
hi: क्या पाँच सौ रुपये के छुट्टे मिलेंगे?
Kya paanch sau rupaye ke chhutte milenge?
en: Do you have change for five hundred rupees?
Doo yoo hav chaynj for fyv huhn-dred roo-peez?
bn: পাঁচশো টাকার খুচরো হবে কি?
Pachsho takar khuchro hobe ki?

sentences.title: Shopping Carry Bag
sentences.meaning: Asking for a cloth or paper shopping bag
hi: सामान के लिए एक थैला दे दीजिए
Saamaan ke liye ek thaila de deejiye
en: Could you give me a carry bag, please?
Kood yoo giv mee uh ka-ree bag, pleez?
bn: জিনিসপত্রের জন্য একটা ব্যাগ দিন
Jinisphotrer jonno ekta bag din

sentences.title: Larger Size Stationery
sentences.meaning: Inquiring about notebook dimensions in bookstore
hi: क्या यह नोटबुक बड़े साइज़ में है?
Kya yeh notebook bade size mein hai?
en: Do you have this notebook in a larger size?
Doo yoo hav dhis noht-book in uh lar-jur syz?
bn: এই খাতাটার বড় সাইজ পাওয়া যাবে?
Ei khata-tar boro size paowa jabe?

sentences.title: Payment Confirmation
sentences.meaning: Informing merchant after successful online money transfer
hi: मैंने पैसे भेज दिए हैं, अपना फोन चेक कीजिए
Maine paise bhej diye hain, apna phone check kijiye
en: I have sent the payment, please check
Eye hav sent dhuh pay-muhnt, pleez chek
bn: টাকাটা পাঠিয়ে দিয়েছি, একটু ফোনটা দেখুন
Taka-ta pathiye diyechi, ektu phone-ta dekhun
te: డబ్బులు పంపించాను, మీ ఫోన్ ఒకసారి చూడండి
Dabbulu pampinchanu, mee phone okasari chudandi

sentences.title: Plumbing Complaint
sentences.meaning: Reporting a hostel water supply problem to warden
hi: कमरा नंबर 204 में पानी नहीं आ रहा है
Kamra number 204 mein paani nahi aa raha hai
en: There is no water coming in room 204
Dhair iz noh wah-tur kum-ing in room too-oh-for
bn: ২০৪ নম্বর ঘরে জল আসছে না
Dushow char nombor ghore jol aashche na
te: రూమ్ నంబర్ 204 లో నీళ్లు రావడం లేదు
Room number 204 lo neellu ravadam ledu

sentences.title: Hostel Curfew
sentences.meaning: Inquiring about night curfew gate closing hours
hi: रात को हॉस्टल का गेट कितने बजे बंद होता है?
Raat ko hostel ka gate kitne baje band hota hai?
en: What time does the hostel gate lock at night?
Wuht tym duhz dhuh hos-tuhl gayt lok at nyt?
bn: রাতে হোস্টেলের মেন গেট কটায় বন্ধ হয়?
Raate hostel-er main gate kotay bondho hoy?
te: రాత్రి హాస్టల్ గేటు ఎన్ని గంటలకు మూస్తారు?
Rathri hostel gate enni gantalaku moostharu?

sentences.title: Courier Delivery
sentences.meaning: Checking security desk for online parcel delivery
hi: क्या मेरे नाम का कोई कूरियर पार्सल आया है?
Kya mere naam ka koi courier parcel aaya hai?
en: Has any courier delivery arrived for me?
Haz eh-nee koor-ee-ur deh-liv-uh-ree uh-ryvd for mee?
bn: আমার নামে কি কোনো কুরিয়ার পার্সেল এসেছে?
Aamar naame ki kono courier parcel esheche?
te: నా పేరు మీద ఏదైనా కొరియర్ పార్శిల్ వచ్చిందా?
Naa peru meeda edaina courier parcel vachinda?

sentences.title: Hostel Wi-Fi Down
sentences.meaning: Reporting internet outage on the floor
hi: इस फ्लोर का वाई-फाई नहीं चल रहा है
Is floor ka Wi-Fi nahi chal raha hai
en: The internet Wi-Fi on this floor is down
Dhuh in-tur-net wy-fy on dhis flor iz down
bn: এই ফ্লোরের ওয়াই-ফাই কাজ করছে না
Ei floor-er Wi-Fi kaaj korche na
te: ఈ ఫ్లోర్‌లో వై-ఫై పని చేయడం లేదు
Ee floor-lo Wi-Fi pani cheyadam ledu

sentences.title: Laundry Area
sentences.meaning: Locating hostel washing machines and drying lines
hi: कपड़े धोने और सुखाने की जगह कहाँ है?
Kapde dhone aur sukhaane ki jagah kahan hai?
en: Where is the place to wash and dry laundry?
Wair iz dhuh plays too wosh and dry lawn-dree?
bn: জামাকাপড় ধোওয়া এবং শুকানোর জায়গা কোনটা?
Jaamakapor dhowa ebong shukanor jaayga konta?
te: బట్టలు ఉతుక్కోవడానికి, ఆరేయడానికి స్థలం ఎక్కడ ఉంది?
Battalu uthukkovadaniki, aareyadaniki sthalam ekkada undi?

sentences.title: Exam Study Quiet
sentences.meaning: Asking neighbours for quiet hours during exam preparation
hi: गाना थोड़ा धीमा बजाओगे? कल मेरी परीक्षा है
Gaana thoda dheema bajaoge? Kal meri pareeksha hai
en: Could you lower the sound? I have an exam tomorrow
Kood yoo loh-wur dhuh sownd? Eye hav an eg-zam tuh-mah-roh
bn: গানের আওয়াজটা একটু কমাবে? কাল আমার পরীক্ষা আছে
Ganer aowaz-ta ektu komabe? Kaal aamar porikkha aache
te: సౌండ్ కొంచెం తగ్గిస్తారా? రేపు నాకు పరీక్ష ఉంది
Sound konchem thaggisthara? Repu naaku pareeksha undi

sentences.title: Weekend Outpass
sentences.meaning: Requesting warden outpass signature for visiting family
hi: वार्डन सर, मुझे वीकेंड पर घर जाने के लिए आउटपास चाहिए
Warden sir, mujhe weekend par ghar jaane ke liye outpass chahiye
en: Warden sir, I need a weekend leave outpass
War-duhn sur, eye need uh week-end leev owt-pas
bn: ওয়ার্ডেন স্যার, ছুটির দিনে বাইরে যাওয়ার পাস দরকার
Warden sir, chutir dine baire jaowar pass dorkar
te: వార్డెన్ సార్, వారాంతంలో ఇంటికి వెళ్ళడానికి ఔట్‌పాస్ కావాలి
Warden sir, varanthamlo intiki velladaniki outpass kavali

sentences.title: Hometown Introduction
sentences.meaning: Polite icebreaker with fellow students
hi: नमस्ते! आप मूल रूप से कहाँ के रहने वाले हैं?
Namaste! Aap mool roop se kahan ke rehne waale hain?
en: Hello! Which state or city are you from?
Hel-loh! Which stayt or sit-ee ar yoo fruhm?
bn: নমস্কার! আপনার বাড়ি আসলে কোন শহরে?
Nomoshkar! Aapnar bari aashole kon shohore?

sentences.title: Department & Branch
sentences.meaning: Inquiring about academic fields of study
hi: आपकी पढ़ाई की कौन सी ब्रांच है?
Aapki padhai ki kaun si branch hai?
en: Which department or branch are you studying in?
Which dih-part-muhnt or branch ar yoo stuh-dee-ing in?
bn: আপনার ডিপার্টমেন্ট এবং ব্রাঞ্চ কী?
Aapnar department ebong branch kee?

sentences.title: Evening Chai Invitation
sentences.meaning: Gathering hostel friends for chai break outing
hi: चलो, शाम को साथ में चाय पीने चलते हैं!
Chalo, shaam ko saath mein chai peene chalte hain!
en: Come, let us all go have tea together!
Kum, let uhs awl goh hav tee tuh-gedh-ur!
bn: চলুন, বিকেলে একসাথে চা খেতে যাই!
Cholun, bikele ekshathe cha khete jaai!
te: రండి, సాయంత్రం అందరం కలిసి టీ తాగుదాం!
Randi, sayanthram andaram kalisi tea thaagudam!

sentences.title: Exchange Numbers
sentences.meaning: Exchanging phone contacts with new acquaintances
hi: आपसे मिलकर बहुत अच्छा लगा! आपका नंबर क्या है?
Aapse milkar bahut achha laga! Aapka number kya hai?
en: It was great meeting you! Can I get your number?
It wuz grayt mee-ting yoo! Kan eye get yoor nuhm-bur?
bn: আপনার সাথে আলাপ হয়ে খুব ভালো লাগল! ফোন নম্বরটা দেবেন?
Aapnar shathe aalaap hoye khoob bhalo laglo! Phone number-ta deben?
te: మిమ్మల్ని కలవడం చాలా సంతోషం! మీ ఫోన్ నంబర్ ఎంత?
Mimmalni kalavadam chala santhosham! Mee phone number entha?

sentences.title: Play Sports
sentences.meaning: Inviting hostel mates for evening sports on ground
hi: क्या आज शाम को क्रिकेट या बैडमिंटन खेलोगे?
Kya aaj shaam ko cricket ya badminton kheloge?
en: Would you like to play sports this evening?
Wood yoo lyk too play sports dhis eev-ning?
bn: আজ বিকেলে ক্রিকেট বা ব্যাডমিন্টন খেলবেন নাকি?
Aaj bikele cricket ba badminton khelben naaki?
te: ఈ సాయంత్రం క్రికెట్ లేదా బ్యాడ్మింటన్ ఆడదామా?
Ee sayanthram cricket leda badminton aadadama?

sentences.title: Speak Slower Request
sentences.meaning: Asking local speaker to slow down for comprehension
hi: मैं अभी यह भाषा सीख रहा हूँ, कृपया थोड़ा धीरे बोलिए
Main abhi yeh bhasha seekh raha hoon, kripya thoda dheere boliye
en: I am still learning, please speak a bit slower
Eye am stil lur-ning, pleez speek uh bit sloh-wur
bn: আমি এখনও এই ভাষাটা শিখছি, একটু আস্তে বলবেন দয়া করে
Ami ekhono ei bhasha-ta shikhchi, ektu aaste bolben doya kore
te: నేను ఇప్పుడే ఈ భాష నేర్చుకుంటున్నాను, కొంచెం నెమ్మదిగా మాట్లాడండి
Nenu ippude ee bhasha nerchukuntunnanu, konchem nemmadiga matladandi

sentences.title: Saying Thank You
sentences.meaning: Learning local politeness and gratitude phrase
hi: आपकी मातृभाषा में 'बहुत-बहुत धन्यवाद' कैसे कहते हैं?
Aapki matribhasha mein 'bahut bahut dhanyavaad' kaise kehte hain?
en: How do you say 'Thank you' in your mother tongue?
How doo yoo say thank yoo in yoor muh-dhur tuhng?
bn: আপনার মাতৃভাষায় 'অনেক ধন্যবাদ' কীভাবে বলে?
Aapnar matribhashay 'onek dhonnobad' keebhabe bole?
te: మీ మాతృభాషలో 'చాలా ధన్యవాదాలు' అని ఎలా అంటారు?
Mee mathrubhashalo 'chala dhanyavadalu' ani ela antaru?

sentences.title: Weekend Outing
sentences.meaning: Planning weekend trip to local tourist spots with classmates
hi: क्या इस रविवार को शहर घूमने के लिए खाली हो?
Kya is ravivar ko shahar ghoomne ke liye khaali ho?
en: Are you free this Sunday to visit the city?
Ar yoo free dhis Suhn-day too viz-it dhuh sit-ee?
bn: এই রবিবার শহরটা ঘুরে দেখতে যাবেন নাকি?
Ei robibar shohor-ta ghure dekhte jaben naaki?
te: ఈ ఆదివారం నగరం చూడటానికి ఖాళీగా ఉన్నారా?
Ee aadivaram nagaram chudataniki khaaliga unnara?

sentences.title: Nearest Pharmacy
sentences.meaning: Asking for emergency medicine chemist shop
hi: पास में दवा की दुकान कहाँ है?
Paas mein dawa ki dukaan kahan hai?
en: Where is the nearest medical store?
Wair iz dhuh neer-est med-ih-kuhl stor?
bn: কাছের ওষুধের দোকানটা কোথায়?
Kaacher oshudher dokan-ta kothay?

sentences.title: Headache and Fever
sentences.meaning: Explaining symptoms to college dispensary doctor
hi: मुझे बहुत तेज़ सिरदर्द और बुखार है
Mujhe bahut tez sirdard aur bukhaar hai
en: I have a bad headache and fever
Eye hav uh bad hed-ayk and fee-vur
bn: আমার খুব তীব্র মাথা যন্ত্রণা আর জ্বর এসেছে
Aamar khoob teebro matha jontrona aar jwor esheche

sentences.title: Stomach Ache Relief
sentences.meaning: Requesting stomach pain relief at pharmacy
hi: पेट दर्द के लिए कोई दवाई दे दीजिए
Pet dard ke liye koi dawai de deejiye
en: Please give me some medicine for stomach ache
Pleez giv mee suhm med-ih-sin for stuhm-uk ayk
bn: পেট ব্যথার জন্য একটা ওষুধ দিন, দয়া করে
Pet byathar jonno ekta oshudh din, doya kore

sentences.title: Medication Dosage
sentences.meaning: Asking pharmacist about prescription dosage and schedule
hi: यह गोली दिन में कितनी बार खानी है?
Yeh goli din mein kitni baar khaani hai?
en: How many times a day should I take this tablet?
How men-ee tymz uh day wood eye tayk dhis tab-luht?
bn: এই ট্যাবলেটটা দিনে কতবার খেতে হবে?
Ei tablet-ta dine kotobar khete hobe?
te: ఈ మాత్రను రోజుకు ఎన్ని సార్లు వేసుకోవాలి?
Ee mathranu rojuku enni saarlu vesukovali?

sentences.title: Call Ambulance
sentences.meaning: Calling for emergency hospital vehicle assistance
hi: जल्दी एम्बुलेंस बुलाइए, यह इमरजेंसी है!
Jaldi ambulance bulaiye, yeh emergency hai!
en: Please call an ambulance, it is urgent!
Pleez kawl an am-byoo-luhns, it iz ur-juhnt!
bn: তাড়াতাড়ি অ্যাম্বুলেন্স ডাকুন, জরুরি দরকার!
Tarathari ambulance dakun, joruri dorkar!

sentences.title: Allergy Check
sentences.meaning: Inquiring about medical drug allergies
hi: क्या आपको किसी दवाई से एलर्जी है?
Kya aapko kisi dawai se allergy hai?
en: Are you allergic to any medications?
Ar yoo uh-lur-jik too eh-nee med-ih-kay-shuhnz?
bn: আপনার কি কোনো ওষুধের প্রতি অ্যালার্জি আছে?
Aapnar ki kono oshudher proti allergy aache?

sentences.title: Urgent Doctor Request
sentences.meaning: Asking hostel warden or security for immediate doctor assistance
hi: मुझे तुरंत डॉक्टर की ज़रूरत है, मदद कीजिए
Mujhe turant doctor ki zaroorat hai, madad kijiye
en: I urgently need a doctor, please help me
Eye ur-juhnt-lee need uh dok-tur, pleez help mee
bn: আমার এখনই ডাক্তার দরকার, দয়া করে সাহায্য করুন
Aamar ekhoni doctor dorkar, doya kore sahajjo korun
te: నాకు వెంటనే డాక్టర్ అవసరం, దయచేసి సహాయం చేయండి
Naaku ventane doctor avasaram, dayachesi sahayam cheyandi
